scenes.title: The Forgotten Letter
scenes.summary: Gabriel discovers he never sent the letter to the agency's ally at the tax office. At a crisis meeting the partners learn that the audit has moved to another department and turn on him.

scenes.title: I Am the Seagull
scenes.summary: At reception Sofia rehearses Nina's speech from Chekhov's The Seagull. Nathalie Baye recognises the play and advises her, then comments on her daughter Laura Smet's posture when their agents arrive.

scenes.title: An Exclusive Script
scenes.summary: Gabriel gives Laura the 'only copy' of Solveig Akerfelt's new script; then she learns Mathias has given the same script to Nathalie: mother and daughter are both wanted, for the mother and the daughter.

scenes.title: Gabriel vs Mathias
scenes.summary: Gabriel accuses Mathias of using moles to get the script; Mathias says a mother-daughter billing is good for the agency.

scenes.title: Mathias asks a favour
scenes.summary: Mathias phones the producer Dominique to ask an internship for 'a friend's daughter', Camille; Camille catches him by her desk.

scenes.title: An Invitation to the Césars
scenes.summary: Camille has an invitation to the Césars; Noémie and Hervé, who didn't get one, are jealous, and Camille invents reasons why Andréa gave it to her.

scenes.title: An Ex at the Tax Office
scenes.summary: Andréa has an idea for the audit: an ex of hers, Clément, is high up at the tax office; then Gabriel wonders how Mathias got the 'exclusive' script.

scenes.title: Hervé meets Hugo
scenes.summary: Hervé chats up Hugo, a delivery boy and film student, and promises to keep him posted about Akerfelt's film.

scenes.title: Sofia's Photo
scenes.summary: The casting director has picked Sofia, who slipped her own photo in with the agency's; Gabriel says she can't pretend to be on their books, she says nobody comes to see her show, and he promises to come.

scenes.title: Three Months on a Boat
scenes.summary: On the phone Laura tells Gabriel she loves the script but can't spend three months on a trawler with her mother.

scenes.title: Clément at the Tax Office
scenes.summary: Andréa visits her ex Clément: he says the inspector, Colette Brancillon, is a stickler; after Andréa's bribes of Cannes passes and a suite, he agrees to try to replace her within a week.

scenes.title: Thank you, Dad
scenes.summary: Camille thanks Mathias for the César invitation; he says she'll meet people from the business.

scenes.title: Christophe Lambert's Daughter
scenes.summary: Noémie saw Mathias put the envelope on Camille's desk and accuses her of spying for him; Camille says her father is a married star client of Mathias, and Noémie decides it's Christophe Lambert.

scenes.title: The Tax Inspector Arrives
scenes.summary: Colette Brancillon arrives for the audit; Andréa feels she knows her, then calls Clément to cancel the deal; the partners fear going bust.

scenes.title: Mother and Daughter, Three Months
scenes.summary: Nathalie and Laura discuss the script; in separate talks with their agents each says three months alone together would be impossible: 'I want to act it, not live it'.

scenes.title: Act Like a Star
scenes.summary: Nathalie and Laura separately remember a disastrous summer together. Laura fears hurting her mother by refusing the film; Hervé suggests behaving like an impossible star so the director rejects her, while Gabriel objects.

scenes.title: Nathalie's Audition
scenes.summary: Nathalie reads for Solveig Akerfelt, first with great tragedy, then, asked to be more neutral, in the same tragic way.

scenes.title: Laura's Diva Act
scenes.summary: Laura auditions next and behaves like a diva over her Himalayan tea; later Gabriel's voicemail says Akerfelt finds her 'too beautiful for the part'.

scenes.title: Dressing for the Césars
scenes.summary: While Camille dresses for the Césars, her mother helps by laptop video call from the south of France, worries about Mathias and asks for photos of stars.

scenes.title: I Want to Be an Agent
scenes.summary: At the Césars Mathias introduces Camille to producer Dominique Besnehard, who offers her an internship on a Guillaume Gallienne film.

scenes.title: I want to be an agent
scenes.summary: Next morning Camille tells Mathias she won't call Besnehard: she wants to learn to be an agent.

scenes.title: A Bad Idea
scenes.summary: The partners learn that Akerfelt has rejected Nathalie Baye. Back in his office, Gabriel blames Hervé for Laura's difficult-star act and pretends to fire him before admitting it is a joke.

scenes.title: The coffee machine
scenes.summary: An actor shows off the office coffee machine, a Portuguese brand.

scenes.title: Shooting Yourself in the Foot
scenes.summary: Gabriel persuades Solveig to reconsider Laura by claiming that bad auditions are a French actors' tradition. Later Noémie brings news that the director wants to see mother and daughter together.

scenes.title: The Woman from the Website
scenes.summary: Andréa realises Colette is the woman she insulted on the dating site; Colette rejects her apology and her charm.

scenes.title: Ten out of Ten
scenes.summary: Akerfelt wants both actresses precisely because they don't want to work together; mother and daughter end up having a real row in front of her.

scenes.title: Ten out of ten, and no
scenes.summary: Akerfelt gives them ten out of ten, but mother and daughter refuse the film; they hope to make one together one day.

scenes.title: Andréa's Papers
scenes.summary: Andréa gives Colette the requested papers, accidentally including medical results. Outside the agency, Gabriel comments on Andréa's need for control and invites her to dinner; she declines, and he accepts her answer.
scenes.location: ASK office / street outside the agency

scenes.title: Sofia's play
scenes.summary: Sofia performs in her play 'Absence'.

scenes.title: I Want to Be Your Agent
scenes.summary: After the play, Sofia thanks Gabriel for coming; he says she's a real actress and offers to be her agent.

scenes.title: StarMédia's offer
scenes.summary: François, the boss of StarMédia, offers Mathias to join them with all his clients and run the biggest agency in Paris; ASK would be finished.
